svg.title: FinAware — Flow: Get Help
svg.text: Asking an advisor for help (A), and the three tools linked from the Get Help page: the Debt Review Check (B), the Case Summary (C) and the loan-offer check (D). The advisor suggestion is only a suggestion — the person chooses.
worked out in the web app, on the server; lib/finance/debt-review.ts

in the browser only — the message is not sent anywhere or saved; lib/finance/offer-check.ts
On the Get Help page: the message, and the kind of advisor
Suggest an advisor at once — keywords, in the browser
From 15 characters. The words that decide it:
summons, sheriff, court, judgment, garnishee, section 129, repossession,
debt review, can't afford or pay, arrears, missed payments, creditors calling,
budget, saving, investing, retirement, tax, insurance
Refine it — after a 600 ms pause in typing
Answered inside the web app (lib/help/triage.ts); nothing is stored
"Route this South African user's request to one of three advisors … Anything with a
legal deadline goes to LEGAL_ADVISOR. Give one short reason, starting with 'you'."
A valid answer — one of the
matter and the model did not?
The web app answers with the keywords (source: keywords), so the browser
keeps the suggestion from step 2 when:
• the message is under 20 characters, there is no OpenAI key, or model calls
are paused for 10 minutes after a 401 or out-of-credit reply
• the model's answer is not one of the three advisors
• a legal keyword was found — a summons does not wait for a second opinion
"A Debt Counsellor looks right — you are behind on payments", with a button to
Either way, the choice stays with the person

The request is also listed under past requests
Prisma: Users, Debts (+ payment history), Legal_Records
Can be included · maybe (e.g. business credit — a counsellor to
confirm) · cannot (e.g. child maintenance). A garnished account stays
in the sums but cannot be restructured.
Income − living costs − payments debt review cannot cover = available
Available − repayments it could cover = left over, or short, every month
Possible — left over under 10% of income (under 25% with missed
Unlikely — enough left over, or nothing it could restructure
Not suitable — no income · Need more information — living costs not given

A screen, not an assessment — only a registered debt counsellor can declare
What needs attention first, the accounts, the figures, and the Debt Review screen

A one-page summary for an advisor
Without OpenAI the calculated summary is shown as it is
An SMS, a WhatsApp message or an offer — or try an example such
Amount, interest rate, term, fees, and an NCR registration number
Scam signs: money before paying out · keeps your ID or bank card ·
asks for a PIN or one-time code · pay by voucher, e-wallet or airtime
Cautions: no credit check · pressure to act now · WhatsApp or
The most a registered lender may charge for the same amount and
term: interest at the cap for the credit type (tied to the repo rate), plus
the maximum initiation and service fees, with VAT
Costs more than every legal charge added together
